Run context

Tell the workflow what the files can't, and see before you pay for a run which modules have what they need. Every stage explains who uses your answer.

    What do you need from this run?

    Your answer picks the pathway: the analytical modules CP-OS runs, in order. The next stages ask only for what those modules use.

    Pathway

    What is the market situation?

    Why it matters. A paid run cannot be patched: if the context changes, every module runs again (a resumed run refuses changed context). Choosing the right pathway now is the cheapest fix there is.

    Who is the issuer?

    Every module is checked for naming this issuer: its handoff must name the issuer, an alias or the ID. Source readiness (CP-0) blocks the run on an unresolved identity.

    The name the filings use for the group. Plain text.

    Filled from the name. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 40 characters (the inbox refuses longer). Keep the same ID for every run on this issuer: the library files runs by it.

    One per line: the legal name if it differs, the short name, the ticker. A handoff that names the issuer only by an alias you left out fails the identity check.

    Issue classification

    Classify by the debt this run analyses; for split-rated or unrated issuers use your firm's convention. The methods are written for high-yield and leveraged-loan credit.

    Which dates and periods?

    The as-of date is the day the analysis stands on, not the end of the reporting period. Evidence published after it is treated as not yet available.

    The filing or publication date of the latest file in the folder (for example the 10-Q filing date). Not saved; it only checks the as-of date below.

    On or after the newest file's date. Quotes, ratings, deal terms and peer figures you enter must not be dated after it (they are refused).

    The latest reported period in the folder, as the filing labels it: q1-2026 to q4-2026, h1-2026, h2-2026 or fy-2025 (lowercase). Use the issuer's fiscal labels.

    The period to compare with: earlier than the current period and the same kind (quarter, half or year).

    As the filing cover states it: three uppercase letters.

    Optional. Research items published after this are refused; not after the as-of date. Blank means the as-of date.

    What is in the folder?

    Modules can use only the files you drop with this context. Answer for the files that are really in the folder, not for files that exist somewhere: every module reads these declarations.
